description: An autonomous agent for deep financial research

summary.one_liner: Dexter is an autonomous AI research agent for financial analysis that plans tasks, checks its own work, and pulls live market data, written in TypeScript and run with Bun.
summary.what_it_does: Dexter takes a financial question and breaks it into a step-by-step research plan. It then executes those steps by selecting tools that fetch financial data such as income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. It reviews its own results and iterates until it reaches a data-backed answer. Optional web search is available through Exa or Tavily. It logs every tool call and reasoning step to a JSONL scratchpad file under .dexter/scratchpad/ for inspection. The README also describes an evaluation suite that scores answers against a question dataset using LangSmith and an LLM judge, and a WhatsApp gateway for chatting with the agent. It supports multiple model providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama.
use_cases: research company financials from annual reports
analyze income statements and cash flow trends
answer multi-step questions about public stocks
inspect agent tool calls and reasoning history
benchmark an LLM agent on financial questions
chat with a financial research agent over WhatsApp
how_to_run: cp env.example .env  # then add OPENAI_API_KEY and FINANCIAL_DATASETS_API_KEY
bun dev  # watch mode for development
notable: Plans, executes, and self-validates multi-step financial research, modeled loosely on Claude Code
Writes every tool call and reasoning step to a JSONL scratchpad for auditing
Built-in loop detection and step limits to prevent runaway execution
Includes an LLM-as-judge evaluation suite with a live progress UI
Can be chatted with through a WhatsApp gateway
caveats: Explicitly educational and informational only; not intended for real trading or investment, and outputs may be wrong or outdated
Requires paid or external API keys (OpenAI and Financial Datasets; Exa or Tavily optional for search)
WhatsApp setup and configuration are delegated to a separate gateway README
